### Restaurant Operations Manual Template


Need to get in touch with Toast? Whether you’re considering Toast for your business, need help with your existing system, or have an urgent issue during service, the fastest route depends on what you need.


Below, you’ll find the official[Toast phone numbers](https://pos.toasttab.com/contact) and support options for sales, Customer Care, Payroll, and live chat, plus when each is available and how to get help faster.


If you already know who you need, jump straight to the right contact:


-


**Toast Sales:** (617) 297-1005


-


**Toast U.S. Customer Care:** (617) 682-0225, 7 a.m.–12 a.m. ET, seven days a week


-


**Toast Payroll:** (312) 252-7341, Mon–Fri, 8:30 a.m.–10 p.m. ET


-


**Toast Live chat:** 24/7 in Toast Web, the Toast Now app, and Toast Payroll


## Toast sales phone number


### Call (617) 297-1005 to talk to a sales rep or book a demo


If you're not a Toast customer yet, or you are, and you want to add hardware, locations, or products like online ordering or payroll, sales is the right team. Call (617) 297-1005 to talk through what your restaurant needs, get pricing, or set up a walkthrough of the platform with a rep who works with restaurants like yours.


Prefer not to call? You can[request a demo online](https://pos.toasttab.com/request-demo) , and a rep will reach out to you.


Worth knowing: sales can't help with a broken terminal or a payroll question on an existing account. If you're already up and running, Customer Care is faster.


## Toast customer support phone number


### U.S. customers: (617) 682-0225


Toast Customer Care handles everything after you're live: POS issues, menu changes you can't sort out yourself, payment processing questions, hardware that won't connect, and anything else keeping service from running. Call (617) 682-0225.


You'll get a case number for your request — hang onto it. It's the unique identifier for your issue; it's how the team tracks progress, and it's what you reference if you need to follow up later. You can ask for one during any support interaction.


### Support hours: 7 a.m.–12 a.m. ET, seven days a week


Phone support runs from 7 a.m. to 12 a.m. ET, every day, built around restaurant hours, not office hours, so there's coverage through brunch, dinner rush, and close.


Outside those hours, live chat is available 24/7. If something breaks at 2 a.m. during inventory or prep, chat is your fastest path to a human.

## Other Toast Support Numbers


### Toast Payroll: (312) 252-7341


Payroll has its own team and its own line. Call (312) 252-7341 for anything related to Toast Payroll — pay runs, tax filings, employee records, or onboarding questions. You can also chat with a Payroll agent using the blue chat button in the lower-right corner of any Toast Payroll page.


**Toast Payroll Customer Care hours:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–10 p.m. ET.


One note: if you're working with an onboarding consultant on payroll setup, they don't have a direct phone line. Use the main Payroll number or chat.

### Other Toast teams


-


**Referrals:** referrals@toasttab.com — for the Refer a Restaurant program


### Guest support for Toast Takeout orders


This one's for your guests, not your staff. If a customer has a problem with an order they placed through Toast Takeout, point them to the self-service portal at[guesthelp.toasttab.com](http://guesthelp.toasttab.com/) . Guests contacting Customer Care will get routed there anyway, so sending them straight over saves everyone a step.


### Other ways to contact Toast (beyond the phone)


### 24/7 live chat on Toast Web


Chat is the fastest option most of the time, and it never closes.


1.


Log in to Toast Web.


2.


Select the blue support icon in the bottom-right corner of any page.


3.


Select “Contact support” to start a chat with Customer Care.


You can also start a chat from “Support Center” in the left rail of Toast Web.


Two reasons chat often beats the phone: because you're logged in, you're already authenticated, so there's no verification step before anyone can help you. And you can send screenshots, video, or share your screen right inside the conversation — far easier than describing a menu configuration out loud.


If your issue needs a person, Toast's AI agent routes you to a human agent.


### Chat through the Toast Now app


[Toast Now](https://support.toasttab.com/en/article/Get-Started-with-the-Toast-Now-App) is Toast's mobile app for running your restaurant from your phone — real-time reporting and key controls, wherever you are. Support lives in it too:


1.


Log in to the Toast Now app.


2.


Select the “Support” icon in the bottom navigation bar.


3.


Select “Chat with us” to start a new conversation, or “Messages” to pick up an existing one.


Chats sync everywhere chat is available — Toast Now, Support Center in Toast Web, and Toast Payroll. Start a conversation on the terminal before close, finish it from your phone on the drive home.


Download it for[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6444586410?pt=1364164&ct=Toast%20Central&mt=8) or[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.toasttab.toastoperator) .


### Screen-sharing support during a call


Some problems are much easier to show than explain. Toast lets you share your screen with a Care rep while you're on the phone — from either the POS or Toast Web.


**From your Toast device:**


1.


Go to the Support section of your Device Menu.


2.


Select “Start Screen Share.”


3.


A unique code appears on screen — read it to the agent, and they'll connect.


You can also search "Screen Share" on the POS, or find it under Support > Start Screen Share in the overflow menu (top-left arrow). On some terminals, swiping up from the bottom of the screen surfaces the option. The steps are the same on terminals and handhelds.


**From Toast Web:**


1.


Select the “User Icon” to open the dropdown.


2.


Select “Share your screen.”


3.


Give the agent the code that populates.


A few things that make screen shares go smoothly: double-check the code you read out, generate a fresh one if the first doesn't connect, and make sure your internet connection is stable. Screen share won't work if the network is down on your device.

### Check the status page before you call


If something looks broken across the board, the “Status Page” in your Device Menu shows a live status report on the POS's most critical functions, plus a history of past incidents. It's also at[status.toasttab.com](https://status.toasttab.com/) . Two seconds there can save you a phone call.


### What to have ready before you call


A little prep turns a fifteen-minute call into a five-minute one.


### Your case number (if it's a follow-up)


If you've contacted Toast about this issue before, lead with the case number. It pulls up the full history of your request so you're not re-explaining from scratch.


Don't have it handy? Log in to Toast Web and go to “Support Center” — from the left menu, or the question-mark button in the upper-right corner. Select your case to see its details, add a comment or attachment, or chat with an agent in real time about it.


### Account and restaurant details for faster verification


Have these ready:


-


Your restaurant name and location, as it appears in Toast


-


The email address on your Toast account


-


Which device is affected, if it's a hardware or terminal issue


-


What you were doing when the problem happened, and whether it's happened before


-


Any error message, word for word — or a photo of it


If your issue is on a specific terminal, be near it. Most calls end with the agent walking you through something on the device, and a screen share is only useful if you can see the screen.


### Get the right Toast team on the line


Getting help starts with reaching the right team. If you’re exploring Toast or interested in adding new products, call Toast Sales at (617) 297-1005. For help with an existing Toast account, contact Customer Care at (617) 682-0225. For payroll-specific questions, call Toast Payroll at (312) 252-7341.


Prefer to skip the phone? 24/7 live chat is also available through Toast Web, the Toast Now app, and Toast Payroll.


Save the contact information you’re most likely to need now, so if an issue comes up during a busy service, you know exactly where to turn.


### FAQs:


**What is Toast's customer service phone number?**


Toast Customer Care for U.S. customers is (617) 682-0225, available 7 a.m.–12 a.m. ET, seven days a week. Toast Payroll has a separate line at (312) 252-7341, staffed Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–10 p.m. ET.


**What is Toast's sales phone number?**


Call Toast sales at (617) 297-1005 to get pricing, talk through what your restaurant needs, or book a demo. You can also[request a demo online](https://pos.toasttab.com/contact) .


**Is Toast support available 24/7?**


Live chat is available 24/7 through Toast Web, the Toast Now app, and Toast Payroll. Phone support runs 7 a.m.–12 a.m. ET, seven days a week, so chat is the way to reach someone overnight.


**Does Toast have international support numbers?**


Yes. Canada: +1 343 451 6295. Ireland: +353 1 913 1083. U.K.: +44 2045 713302. Australia: +61 879 478 066.


**Can I contact Toast support through chat instead of calling?**


Yes, and it's often faster. Select the blue support icon in the bottom-right corner of any Toast Web or Toast Payroll page, or tap “Support” in the Toast Now app. Because you're logged in, you're already authenticated, so there's no verification step, and you can share screenshots, video, or your screen directly in the chat. Conversations sync across web and mobile, so you can start on one and finish on the other.
